maxPercent.note: Rate framework max, %/year (image re-read 2026-11-02). The image is titled 'Khung lãi suất sản phẩm cho vay tiêu dùng tại Lotte Finance' (effective 01/03/2026) and lists min and max by customer group. It matches the per-product rate range a finance company must set and publish (Circular 43 arts. 9 and 10a), i.e. a company-set range, not a legal cap. It does not say these are the rates borrowers get. Lotte's own loan-list simulator says 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 0% / tháng Hoặc theo kết quả thẩm định' (rate decided at appraisal), so the actual rate is per applicant. Kept as regulatory_ceiling.

basis.note: Not printed on the framework image. Inferred from Lotte's own loan terms (Điều kiện giao dịch chung, ref 01/2025/CVTD, Điều 5 and Điều 8): interest is charged on the actual outstanding balance at a rate R in %/year, and the monthly payment is -PMT(R/12, N, P) (equal instalments on a reducing balance). Lotte's loan contract template (MB01A-MB06B, 'Tổng hợp Mẫu HĐCV') says the same, and Circular 43 art. 10(1)(e) requires the contract %/year rate to be on actual balance. Lotte does not say in so many words that the framework's %/năm is that R, so this is inferred, not stated.

amortization.note: Loan terms Điều 8: monthly amount = -PMT(R/12,N,P), equal instalments, first and last may differ; the product-specific contract (Điều Kiện Riêng) is not published and may differ. The product page quotes the rate 'tính theo dư nợ ban đầu', a flat-equivalent way of quoting the same loan, so the page figure is stored as flat and the schedule as annuity.

representativeExamples.note: Lotte's own iOS app description (general consumer loan, not tied to a scheme code): 'Lãi suất: từ 24%/năm (tùy hồ sơ, tính trên dư nợ giảm dần)', 10 triệu, 12 tháng, 946.000 đ/tháng, tổng 11.339.957 đ (lãi 1.339.957 đ), kỳ cuối có thể khác. Check: PMT(2%/month, 12, 10,000,000) = 945,596, rounded up to 946,000 as the contract rounds to thousands. Our month-by-month check gives about 11,346,600 in total; Lotte's figure is 0.06% lower, consistent with daily actual/365 accrual. The 24% is Lotte's 'from' rate for the app, so this shows the method (annuity, reducing, %/year) and is not a typical or guaranteed rate. Listing is undated; its 5% early-repayment fee disagrees with the 2026 schedule, so it may be older. The repo validator may warn that 12 x 946,000 differs from the total by more than 12,000: the last instalment is smaller.

conflicts.resolution: Different ways of quoting one loan, plus a range. The page floor (0.94%/tháng) is a flat monthly rate on the initial balance; the framework is %/year; Lotte's terms say the contract rate is %/year on actual balance. Our own IRR conversion (not a Lotte figure) of the 0.94%/month flat floor gives about 19-20%/year nominal on a reducing balance for 6-36 months; 19-20%/year is ABOVE the framework minimum of 8% for this group, so the framework minimum is not what the standard scheme charges; the 66% maximum is only the top of a company-set range. The two are stored with their kinds (advertised_floor flat monthly; regulatory_ceiling reducing yearly, inferred). Neither is an offered_range, so neither is used to price a borrower and the product stays excluded. An earlier note said the women's floor converts below the framework minimum; that compared a flat rate with a reducing-balance range and is withdrawn.

conflicts.resolution: Stored 6%, minimum 1.600.000 VND, the conservative value among tier 1 sources (docs/research/data-entry-rules.md section 6). Lotte's dated schedule (Decision 26M135701/203, 29/05/2026) shows 0% for this customer group on contracts from 12/08/2025, so a borrower may pay nothing; ask Lotte to confirm before relying on either figure.

products.notes: Advertised rate is a floor quoted "từ X%/tháng (tính theo dư nợ ban đầu)"; the published rate framework (effective 01/03/2026, https://lottefinance.vn/images/resources/file/KhungLaiSuat_100226.jpg) gives 8%-66%/year (row 4) with basis unstated, so the rate a borrower gets is unknown. The calculator on the loan list page offers 6-60 months; product pages say 6-36; we store 36. 2026-11-02 deep dive: Lotte's loan terms (Điều 5, 8) and contract template say the contract rate is %/year on the actual balance with equal monthly payments (PMT), so the 'từ X%/tháng tính theo dư nợ ban đầu' on the page is a flat-equivalent figure. The framework is Lotte's company-set rate range per customer group (Circular 43 art. 9), not a legal cap, and the loan-list simulator says the rate is decided at appraisal. No scheme-level rate table, worked example for this scheme, or insurance premium is published. A stale hidden attribute in the page source (not displayed) shows the page used to quote a monthly reducing-balance rate with a flat 'dư nợ ban đầu' equivalent about 1.85x lower, which fits this reading; it is not used as a figure. To unlock ranking: Lotte must state a min-max rate for this scheme (product page, scheme-code rate table, or contract) with its basis, or the project must decide to accept the Art. 9 range as offered_range (the data is ready: reducing, yearly, inferred). Framework minimum 8% for this group is below the page floor's reducing equivalent (about 19-20%), so it is probably for sub-schemes not shown on the page.
products.nameEn: Cash loan for customers with salary income

borrowerNotes.vi: Sản phẩm này dành cho người có hợp đồng lao động chính thức và nhận lương qua ngân hàng; hãy xem đủ điều kiện trong phần chi tiết.
borrowerNotes.en: This product is for people with a formal labour contract paid through a bank; see the full conditions in the details.

borrowerNotes.vi: Lotte công bố khung 8–66%/năm cho nhóm khách hàng này. Trang sản phẩm lại quảng cáo từ 0,94%/tháng lãi phẳng, tính theo cách khác, và chúng tôi chưa đối chiếu được hai mức thấp nhất này. Vì vậy chúng tôi tính ở mức cao nhất của khung, 66%/năm. Điều này không có nghĩa Lotte sẽ áp dụng mức đó cho bạn. Lãi suất của bạn ghi trong hợp đồng; hãy hỏi trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: Lotte publishes a range of 8–66% a year for this customer group. Its product page advertises from 0.94% a month flat, which is calculated differently, and we could not reconcile the two minimums. So we calculate at the top of the range, 66% a year. This does not mean Lotte will charge you that rate. Your rate is in your contract; ask before signing.

The page floor (1.04%/tháng) is a flat monthly rate on the initial balance; the framework is %/year; Lotte's terms say the contract rate is %/year on actual balance. Our own IRR conversion (not a Lotte figure) of the 1.04%/month flat floor gives about 21-22%/year nominal on a reducing balance for 6-36 months; 21-22%/year falls inside the framework range for this group. The two are stored with their kinds (advertised_floor flat monthly; regulatory_ceiling reducing yearly, inferred). Neither is an offered_range, so neither is used to price a borrower and the product stays excluded. An earlier note said the women's floor converts below the framework minimum; that compared a flat rate with a reducing-balance range and is withdrawn.

products.notes: Advertised rate is a floor quoted "từ X%/tháng (tính theo dư nợ ban đầu)"; the published rate framework (effective 01/03/2026, https://lottefinance.vn/images/resources/file/KhungLaiSuat_100226.jpg) gives 20%-66%/year (row 6) with basis unstated, so the rate a borrower gets is unknown. Photo of motorbike registration only (not kept). 2026-11-02 deep dive: Lotte's loan terms (Điều 5, 8) and contract template say the contract rate is %/year on the actual balance with equal monthly payments (PMT), so the 'từ X%/tháng tính theo dư nợ ban đầu' on the page is a flat-equivalent figure. The framework is Lotte's company-set rate range per customer group (Circular 43 art. 9), not a legal cap, and the loan-list simulator says the rate is decided at appraisal. No scheme-level rate table, worked example for this scheme, or insurance premium is published. A stale hidden attribute in the page source (not displayed) shows the page used to quote a monthly reducing-balance rate with a flat 'dư nợ ban đầu' equivalent about 1.85x lower, which fits this reading; it is not used as a figure. To unlock ranking: Lotte must state a min-max rate for this scheme (product page, scheme-code rate table, or contract) with its basis, or the project must decide to accept the Art. 9 range as offered_range (the data is ready: reducing, yearly, inferred).

borrowerNotes.vi: Lotte công bố khung 20–66%/năm cho nhóm khách hàng này. Trang sản phẩm lại quảng cáo từ 1,04%/tháng lãi phẳng, tính theo cách khác, và chúng tôi chưa đối chiếu được hai mức thấp nhất này. Vì vậy chúng tôi tính ở mức cao nhất của khung, 66%/năm. Điều này không có nghĩa Lotte sẽ áp dụng mức đó cho bạn. Lãi suất của bạn ghi trong hợp đồng; hãy hỏi trước khi ký.
borrowerNotes.en: Lotte publishes a range of 20–66% a year for this customer group. Its product page advertises from 1.04% a month flat, which is calculated differently, and we could not reconcile the two minimums. So we calculate at the top of the range, 66% a year. This does not mean Lotte will charge you that rate. Your rate is in your contract; ask before signing.

researchNotes: LICENSING: Lotte Finance is on data/licensed-institutions.json (id lotte-finance, SBV finance-company list as of 2026-09-30). Legal name is the SBV list name; the company converted to a general finance company and amended its name on 28/8/2026 (former name Công ty Tài chính TNHH MTV Lotte Việt Nam, still used in the general loan terms ref 01/2025/CVTD). DEEP DIVE 2026-11-02 (rate question). FINDINGS: (1) The 'Khung lãi suất sản phẩm cho vay tiêu dùng' image (effective 01/03/2026) is a company-set min-max range per customer group, the kind a finance company must set per product and publish (Circular 43 arts. 9, 10a). It is not a legal ceiling, but it does not say these are the rates borrowers get either, and Lotte's loan-list simulator says 'Lãi suất chỉ từ 0% / tháng hoặc theo kết quả thẩm định', so the borrower's rate comes from appraisal. Stored as regulatory_ceiling. (2) Basis: Lotte's general loan terms (https://lottefinance.vn/web/service/customer/termAndCond/loanTnC, ref 01/2025/CVTD, Điều 5 and 8) and the contract template PDF (https://lottefinance.vn/images/resources/file/T%E1%BB%95ng%20h%E1%BB%A3p%20M%E1%BA%ABu%20H%C4%90CV_Unlock.pdf) say the contract rate is %/year on actual outstanding balance, 365-day year, payment = -PMT(R/12,N,P). So the framework's %/year is on a reducing balance (stored as inferred) and the product pages' 'từ X%/tháng tính theo dư nợ ban đầu' is a flat-equivalent quote. Our own conversion of the page floors (not Lotte figures): 0.94 -> ~19-20%/yr, 1.04 -> ~21-22%, 1.98 -> ~39-41%, 2.03 -> ~40-42% on a reducing balance for 6-36 months; all but the salaried one sit inside their framework range, and the salaried framework minimum of 8% is well below the page floor. (3) iOS app listing (https://apps.apple.com/vn/app/lotte-finance/id1445990440; Lotte's own statement, undated): 'từ 24%/năm, tính trên dư nợ giảm dần', 10-100 triệu, 6-36 tháng, min income 3 triệu, age 18-60, no processing fee, early repayment 5% of remaining principal, with a worked example (10 triệu, 12 tháng, 24%/năm, 946.000 đ/tháng). Recorded as a representative example on the salaried product; the generic amount minimum, age and income are not copied into products because they differ from the product pages. (4) Insurance: optional (page and terms Điều 20); premium not published; terms say a loan can finance the premium (stored added_to_loan, inferred). SOURCES: lottefinance.vn product pages, loan terms, contract template PDF, early-repayment fee image (Decision 26M135701/203 of 29/05/2026), rate framework image, PayLater terms (ref 02/2024) and Q&A PDFs, borrower insurance page, iOS App Store listing. STILL UNKNOWN (searched, not published): scheme-level rate table or scheme codes beside the framework; product-specific contract terms (Điều Kiện Riêng); insurance premium and insurer; cash-service and partner collection fee amounts; minimum loan amount per product (only the generic 10 triệu from the app listing); PayLater limit, instalment terms and rate; Google Play listing (not found; only a package name com.lotte.finance.vietnam via a third-party site). The product list API /api/loan/getLoanMainList.json needs a session and CSRF token and was not called. Installment loans for goods exist only as framework section B rows; credit cards have fee PDFs not captured. LEADS NOT ADDED: 'My L.Cash Prime' (launched 24/09/2026 per a VNBA member-news repost; 'lên đến 600 triệu', 'từ 0,69%/tháng', civil servants, public employees and salaried at large firms); no lottefinance.vn page found, basis and term not stated, and 600M is above the 100M finance-company consumer cap in Circular 43 art. 3(1), so it needs an official page and a lawyer check (the conversion to a general finance company may change the cap). CONFLICTS (see conflicts[]): terms 6-36 months on product pages vs 6-60 in the list-page calculator (36 stored); early-repayment fee: 0% (segment schedule), 6% min 1.6M (contract template and 'other' row) and 5% (app listing); the salaried and other-lender-history products are stored at 0% from the schedule, which is NOT the conservative value. SURPRISING: the women's product floor (1.04%/month flat, ~22%/yr reducing) is not below the framework minimum, as an earlier note said; it was a flat vs reducing mismatch. Overdue principal accrues at 150% of the non-promotional in-term rate and 10%/year on overdue interest; an 8% contract penalty for not reporting address/contact changes within 5 working days appears to differ from Circular 39 art. 13(4) limits (lawyer question 6). UPDATE 2026-11-04: the four cash loans' group ranges are now offered ranges under DECISIONS #61, costed at the top because the minimums don't reconcile with the page floors.
